title: radio set comprehensive other type in
name: Radio set comprehensive other type in
rule: Radio set must be comprehensive; add Other + type-in if not.
pass_when: Every valid answer is in the set, or Other + type-in covers the rest.
fail_when: Set is incomplete and there is no Other + type-in.
overview: Radio sets must cover every valid answer or offer Other with type-in.
apply_when: Building exclusive radio choices that may not cover every answer.
not_when: Incomplete radio sets without Other plus a type-in field.
agent_hint: Make radio sets comprehensive, or add Other with type-in for the rest.
description: A radio set must be comprehensive. If it cannot cover every valid answer, add Other plus a type-in field for the remainder. Pass when every valid answer is in the set, or Other plus type-in covers the rest. Fail when the set is incomplete and there is no Other plus type-in, leaving some valid answers unreachable.
do_not_claim: Silent preselect of a guessed Other.
